name: Introduction and overview — E-8 JSTARS — aircraft record
title: Introduction and overview — E-8 JSTARS
description: Introduction and overview of the E-8 JSTARS: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The E-8 Joint STARS is a battle-management aircraft built by Northrop Grumman on the Boeing 707 airframe, entering service in 1991. Its side-looking radar tracks ground vehicles across a battlefield in real time. 16 were built; the fleet flew in Desert Storm, the Balkans, Afghanistan, and Iraq before retirement in 2023. Baseline facts: Ground-surveillance battle-management aircraft; service 1991-2023; 16 built on 707 airframes..
